newsitem.title: USA: Arakis stake held by Sands.
newsitem.headline: Arakis stake held by Sands.

text.p: Sands Petroleum AB said on Tuesday it holds an 8.2 percent stake in Arakis Energy Corp or 7,255,800 common shares, and added it plans to seek a seat on Arakis's board.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Sands said its latest transactions were bought from February 7 to March 21 at prices ranging from $3.25 to $4.871 per share.

Sands paid $29,415,725.23 for the shares using general working capital. It said it bought the shares based on the opinion they were undervalued and added that it wants to see Arakis take steps towards maximizing shareholder values.
Sands said it intends to contact Arakis in order to seek representation on its board of directors.

Sands said it is also considering other avenues designed to help maximize the stock's value, including requesting a list of shareholders in order to discuss whether management is acting in their best interest.
Sands, basd in Stockholm, Sweden, is engaged in the business of conducting oil and gas operations. Arakis, based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, is an independent energy company.
